people.name: Great_Sea
people.line: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.

translations.web: “ ‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
translations.bsb: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
translations.kjv: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
translations.asv: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the border thereof: this shall be your west border.
